entries.title: Genesis 39:1
segments: And Joseph was brought down to Egypt; and Potiphar, an officer of Pharaoh's, the captain of the guard, an Egyptian, bought him of the hand of the Ishmaelites, that had brought him down thither.

entries.title: Genesis 39:2
segments: And Jehovah was with Joseph, and he was a prosperous man; and he was in the house of his master the Egyptian.

entries.title: Genesis 39:3
segments: And his master saw that Jehovah was with him, and that Jehovah made all that he did to prosper in his hand.

entries.title: Genesis 39:4
segments: And Joseph found favor in his sight, and he ministered unto him: and he made him overseer over his house, and all that he had he put into his hand.

entries.title: Genesis 39:5
segments: And it came to pass from the time that he made him overseer in his house, and over all that he had, that Jehovah blessed the Egyptian's house for Joseph's sake; and the blessing of Jehovah was upon all that he had, in the house and in the field.

entries.title: Genesis 39:6
segments: And he left all that he had in Joseph's hand; and he knew not aught [that was] with him, save the bread which he did eat. And Joseph was comely, and well-favored.

entries.title: Genesis 39:7
segments: And it came to pass after these things, that his master's wife cast her eyes upon Joseph; and she said, Lie with me.

entries.title: Genesis 39:8
segments: But he refused, and said unto his master's wife, Behold, my master knoweth not what is with me in the house, and he hath put all that he hath into my hand:

entries.title: Genesis 39:9
segments: he is not greater in this house than I; neither hath he kept back anything from me but thee, because thou art his wife: how then can I do this great wickedness, and sin against God?

entries.title: Genesis 39:10
segments: And it came to pass, as she spake to Joseph day by day, that he hearkened not unto her, to lie by her, [or] to be with her.

entries.title: Genesis 39:11
segments: And it came to pass about this time, that he went into the house to do his work; and there was none of the men of the house there within.

entries.title: Genesis 39:12
segments: And she caught him by his garment, saying, Lie with me: and he left his garment in her hand, and fled, and got him out.

entries.title: Genesis 39:13
segments: And it came to pass, when she saw that he had left his garment in her hand, and was fled forth,

entries.title: Genesis 39:14
segments: that she called unto the men of her house, and spake unto them, saying, See, he hath brought in a Hebrew unto us to mock us: he came in unto me to lie with me, and I cried with a loud voice:

entries.title: Genesis 39:15
segments: and it came to pass, when he heard that I lifted up my voice and cried, that he left his garment by me, and fled, and got him out.

entries.title: Genesis 39:16
segments: And she laid up his garment by her, until his master came home.

entries.title: Genesis 39:17
segments: And she spake unto him according to these words, saying, The Hebrew servant, whom thou hast brought unto us, came in unto me to mock me:

entries.title: Genesis 39:18
segments: and it came to pass, as I lifted up my voice and cried, that he left his garment by me, and fled out.

entries.title: Genesis 39:19
segments: And it came to pass, when his master heard the words of his wife, which she spake unto him, saying, After this manner did thy servant to me; that his wrath was kindled.

entries.title: Genesis 39:20
segments: And Joseph's master took him, and put him into the prison, the place where the king's prisoners were bound: and he was there in the prison.

entries.title: Genesis 39:21
segments: But Jehovah was with Joseph, and showed kindness unto him, and gave him favor in the sight of the keeper of the prison.

entries.title: Genesis 39:22
segments: And the keeper of the prison committed to Joseph's hand all the prisoners that were in the prison; and whatsoever they did there, he was the doer of it.

entries.title: Genesis 39:23
segments: The keeper of the prison looked not to anything that was under his hand, because Jehovah was with him; and that which he did, Jehovah made it prosper.
